options.text: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
Isn't this place built a bit out the way?
How do I get further into the monastery?

0666f07b-083d-4bdb-8b64-0885615209d4.title: <player>
0666f07b-083d-4bdb-8b64-0885615209d4.text: Can you heal me? I'm injured.

c83ea4ad-6f42-4e0a-8d86-a8524e038f53.text: Abbot Langley places his hands on your head. You feel a little better.

feb7a5d9-e283-4196-9b66-4d2325d7c16a.title: <player>
feb7a5d9-e283-4196-9b66-4d2325d7c16a.text: Isn't this place built a bit out the way?

6afe4bc6-5df9-4afc-83f2-d445571f1c8a.title: Abbot Langley
6afe4bc6-5df9-4afc-83f2-d445571f1c8a.text:
We like it that way actually! We get disturbed less. We
still get rather a large amount of travellers looking for
sanctuary and healing here as it is!

50fdc60f-29fe-46ca-80d5-51fc33df300a.title: <player>
50fdc60f-29fe-46ca-80d5-51fc33df300a.text: How do I get further into the monastery?

5b300274-adff-4d0a-95af-4b7dcea15e25.title: Abbot Langley
5b300274-adff-4d0a-95af-4b7dcea15e25.text:
I'm sorry but only members of our order are allowed
in the second level of the monastery.

options.text: Well can I join your order?

80ce84b1-eb6d-48a6-ba24-32653d11dbb0.title: <player>
80ce84b1-eb6d-48a6-ba24-32653d11dbb0.text: Well can I join your order?

b45b99aa-43d7-40bd-86c1-b6fd8047771f.title: Abbot Langley
b45b99aa-43d7-40bd-86c1-b6fd8047771f.text:
Ok, I see you are someone suitable for our order.
You may join.

c951be83-6cbc-48a2-8b8e-9227f0dfd76c.title: Abbot Langley
c951be83-6cbc-48a2-8b8e-9227f0dfd76c.text: No. I am sorry, but I feel you are not devout enough.
